arabic text: SAQAA E HARAM, RAKH LENA BHARAM\nHUM DAR PE TUMHAARE AAYE HAIN
english translation text: O QUENCHER OF THE THIRST OF THE FAMILY (OF HUSSAIN), RETAIN OUR\nFAITH AND TRUST IN YOU. WE HAVE COME TO YOUR DOOR

arabic text: ABBAS ABBAS YA ABAL FADHLIL ABBAS! TUM BHI NAHI HUMKO THUKRANA, HUM DUNYA KE THUKRAAE HAIN
english translation text: ABBAS! ABBAS! YA ABAL FADHLIL ABBAS! DO NOT LET US DOWN, THE WORLD HAS LET US ALREADY DOWN.

arabic text: AB SAARE SAHARE TOOT CHUKE. HUME APNE PARAYE LOOT CHUKE\nTUM APNI PANAHO ME LELO HUM GHAM SE BOHOT GHABRAAYE HAIN
english translation text: ALL OUR SUPPORT HAS BEEN SHATTERED; EVERYONE HAS LET US DOWN. TAKE US\nINTO YOUR HAVEN, WE ARE ANXIOUS THROUGH ALL THE GRIEF WE HAVE ENDURED

arabic text: ASHKON KI ZUBAA(N) PEHNCHANTE HO.\nJO DIL ME HAI WHO JAANTE HO.\nHUM KEH NAHI SAKTE TUM SUNLO BAS HAATHON KO PHELAAYE HAIN
english translation text: YOU UNDERSTAND THE WORDS OF TEARS,\nYOU ALSO KNOW WHAT IS IN OUR HEARTS.\nWE CANNOT DESCRIBE OUR FEELINGS IN WORDS, WE HAVE JUST OPENED OUR ARMS TO YOU

arabic text: HAR SOONI GODI KHIL JAAYE – HAR BETI KO RISHTA MILJAAE\nUN CHEHRO(N) KO RONAQ DEDO JO GHAM KE SABAB MURJHAAE HAIN
english translation text: MAY ALL EMPTY LAPS BE FILLED WITH A CHILD; MAY ALL DAUGHTERS GET\nA SUITABLE PARTNER. GIVE HAPPINESS TO THOSE FACES WHICH ARE FILLED WITH SADNESS

arabic text: MOLA TUM BAAB E HAWAAIJ HO – ROZE PE UNHE BHI BULWALO\nGHURBAT KE SABAB JO AA NA SAKE HUM UNKE AREEZE LAAYE HAIN
english translation text: MASTER, YOU FULFIL OUR WISHES, PLEASE CALL EVERYONE TO YOUR SHRINE. THOSE THAT HAVE\nNOT BEEN ABLE TO MAKE IT, WE HAVE BROUGHT THEIR WISHES (LETTERS) TO YOU

arabic text: KHA KHA KE TAMACHE ROTI HAI – ZINDA KI KHAAK PE SOTI HAI. BUJH JAAYE PYAAS SAKINA HUM AANKH AANSU LAAYE
english translation text: SHE CRIES BECAUSE OF THE SLAPS, AND SLEEPS ON THE FLOOR OF THE PRISON. WE HAVE BROUGHT OUR TEARS TO QUENCH THE THIRST OF SAKINA

arabic text: DARBAAR SAKHI ABBAS KA THA – KUCH MAANGNA THA LAZIM MAANGA. LEKIN YEH HAQEEQAT BHI HAI QAMAR HUM PURSA DENE AAYE HAI
english translation text: THE DOOR WAS OF THE GENEROUS ABBAS, WE ASKED FOR AS MUCH AS WE WANTED. THE TRUTH IS HOWEVER, WE HAVE COME HERE TO PAY OUR RESPECTS AND GIVE CONDOLENCES
